# Variability data
## fas
```{r}
fasfiles <- list.files(path = fasfiles_path, pattern = "\\.aln.fas", full.names = TRUE)
#fasfiles

aln_protein_names <- sapply(basename(fasfiles), function(x) {
  if (grepl("^\\d+[ _]SP_\\d{4}", x)) {
    # number + (space or underscore) + SP_xxxx
    sub(".*(SP_\\d{4}).*", "\\1", x)
  } else {
    # number + (space or underscore) + Name
    sub("^\\d+[ _]([^_]+).*", "\\1", x)
  }
})


aln_protein_names
```

## Translation & realignment

1. convert DNA to AA, removing any gaps in the aligned DNA sequences 
2. redo the alignments on AA level using DECIPHER

```{r, warning=FALSE}
data_variability <- NULL

for (fasfile in fasfiles) {
  print(basename(fasfile))
  
  protein_name <- sapply(basename(fasfile), function(x) {
    if (grepl("^\\d+[ _]SP_\\d{4}", x)) {
      # number + (space or underscore) + SP_xxxx
      sub(".*(SP_\\d{4}).*", "\\1", x)
    } else {
      # number + (space or underscore) + Name
      sub("^\\d+[ _]([^_]+).*", "\\1", x)
    }
  })
  
  output_file_name <- sub("\\.aln\\.fas$", ".AA.aln.fas", basename(fasfile))
  
  output_file_path <- file.path(AA_fasfiles_path, output_file_name)
  
  tryCatch({
    # Attempt to read the file
    dna_seqs <- readDNAStringSet(fasfile) 
    #print(dna_seqs)
    
    dna_ungapped <- RemoveGaps(dna_seqs)
    
    aa_seqs <- translate(dna_ungapped)

    #print(aa_seqs)
    
    # Perform the alignment
    alignment <- AlignSeqs(aa_seqs,
                          gapOpening = c(-18, -10),
                          gapExtension = -3)
    
    aligned_aa_seqs <- as(alignment, "AAStringSet")
    #print(aligned_aa_seqs)
    
    writeXStringSet(aligned_aa_seqs, filepath = output_file_path, format = "fasta")
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Skipping file due to error:", fasfile, "\nError message:", e$message))
  })
  
}

```

### Determine variability
```{r, warning=FALSE}
AA_fasfiles <- list.files(path = AA_fasfiles_path, pattern = "\\.AA.aln.fas", full.names = TRUE)
data_variability <- NULL

for (fasfile in AA_fasfiles) {
  print(basename(fasfile))
  
  protein_name <-  sapply(basename(fasfile), function(x) {
    if (grepl("^\\d+[ _]SP_\\d{4}", x)) {
      # number + (space or underscore) + SP_xxxx
      sub(".*(SP_\\d{4}).*", "\\1", x)
    } else {
      # number + (space or underscore) + Name
      sub("^\\d+[ _]([^_]+).*", "\\1", x)
    }
  })
  
  tryCatch({
    aligned_aa_seqs <- readAAStringSet(fasfile)
    #print(aligned_aa_seqs)
    
    alignment_matrix <- as.matrix(aligned_aa_seqs)
    
    # Determine consensus sequence manually
    consensus_seq <- apply(alignment_matrix, 2, function(col) {
      residues <- col
      unique_residues <- unique(col)
      most_frequent <- names(sort(table(residues), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
    })
    
    # Variability ignoring gaps ("-")
    variability_counts <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(alignment_matrix)), function(i) {
      sum(alignment_matrix[, i] != consensus_seq[i] & alignment_matrix[, i] != "-" & consensus_seq[i] != "-")
    })
    
    variability_frequencies <- variability_counts / length(aligned_aa_seqs)
    
    # Variability including gaps ("-")
    gap_counts <- sapply(seq_len(ncol(alignment_matrix)), function(i) {
      sum(alignment_matrix[, i] == "-")
    })
    
    gap_freq <- gap_counts / length(aligned_aa_seqs)
    
    indel_type <- ifelse(consensus_seq == "-", "insertion", "deletion")
    
    # Residue table (sorted by frequency)
    residue_tables <- apply(alignment_matrix, 2, function(col) {
      sorted_table <- sort(table(col), decreasing = TRUE)
      paste0(names(sorted_table), ":", as.integer(sorted_table), collapse = "; ")
    })
    
    total_sequences <- length(aligned_aa_seqs)
    sequence_length <- length(consensus_seq)
    
    residue_tables <- apply(alignment_matrix, 2, function(col) {
      sorted_table <- sort(table(col), decreasing = TRUE)
      paste0(names(sorted_table), ":", as.integer(sorted_table), collapse = "; ")
    })
    
    data_variability_subset <- data.frame(
      protein = rep(protein_name, sequence_length),
      position = 1:sequence_length,
      consensus_res = consensus_seq,
      residue_tables = residue_tables,
      var_counts = variability_counts,
      var_freq = variability_frequencies,
      gap_counts = gap_counts,
      gap_freq = gap_freq,
      indel_type = indel_type,
      n_seq = length(aligned_aa_seqs),
      seq_length = length(consensus_seq)
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        indel_counts = case_when(
          indel_type == "deletion" ~ gap_counts, 
          indel_type == "insertion" ~ n_seq - gap_counts, 
          TRUE ~ 0    ),
        indel_freq = indel_counts / n_seq
      )
    
    data_variability <- rbind(data_variability, data_variability_subset)
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("Skipping file due to error:", fasfile, "\nError message:", e$message))
  })
  
}

data_variability
```

# plot
```{r}
for (proteinindex in unique(data_variability$protein)) {
  data_subset <- data_variability %>% filter(protein == proteinindex)
  
  plot <- data_subset %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=position, y=var_counts, fill=var_freq)) +
    geom_col() +
    #scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 20), breaks = 1:20) +
    labs(title = paste0(proteinindex,"\nnumber of seqs: ",unique(data_subset$n_seq))) 
    
    print(plot)
}

```

```{r}
for (proteinindex in unique(data_variability$protein)) {
  data_subset <- data_variability %>% filter(protein == proteinindex)
  
  data_long <- data_subset %>%
    gather(key = "count_type", value = "count_value", var_counts, indel_counts) %>%
    mutate(
      count_type = case_when(
        count_type == "var_counts" ~ "Variation",  
        indel_type == "insertion" ~ "Insertion", 
        indel_type == "deletion" ~ "Deletion",    
        TRUE ~ "Other"                           
      ),
      count_type = factor(count_type, levels = rev(c("Deletion", "Insertion", "Variation")))
    )
  
  plot <- data_long %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = position, y = count_value, fill = count_type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    labs(title = paste0(proteinindex,"\nnumber of seqs: ",unique(data_subset$n_seq))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Variation" = "black", "Insertion" = "skyblue", "Deletion" = "maroon")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(data_long$n_seq)),
                       expand = c(0, 0) ) +
    scale_x_discrete(
      limits = c(0, max(data_long$seq_length)),
      expand = c(0, 0)  
    ) +
    
    theme_bw()
  
  print(plot)
}
```


```{r}
for (proteinindex in unique(data_variability$protein)) {
  data_subset <- data_variability %>% filter(protein == proteinindex)
  
  data_long <- data_subset %>%
    gather(key = "count_type", value = "count_value", var_counts, indel_counts) %>%
    mutate(
      count_type = case_when(
        count_type == "var_counts" ~ "Variation",  
        indel_type == "insertion" ~ "Insertion", 
        indel_type == "deletion" ~ "Deletion",    
        TRUE ~ "Other"                           
      ),
      count_type = factor(count_type, levels = rev(c("Deletion", "Insertion", "Variation"))),
      freq_value = count_value / n_seq
    )
  
  plot <- data_long %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = position, y = freq_value, fill = count_type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    labs(title = paste0(proteinindex,"\nnumber of seqs: ",unique(data_subset$n_seq))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Variation" = "black", "Insertion" = "skyblue", "Deletion" = "maroon")) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    theme_bw()
    
    print(plot)
}
```
